tables.title: IOI behaviour over generations (2026 rows new; originals reused from run/replication + 001)

figures.caption: IOI mean logit-diff (IO−S) vs approximate release year, GPT-2 (2019) → Pythia (2023) → modern-2024 → 2026 flagships (stars). IOI behaviour holds and strengthens into 2026 (all 2026 points ≥ +5.4, well above the GPT-2-small anchor 3.49, dashed); the 2023 Pythia family is the only generation that fails (at/below 0). Originals reused from disk; 2026 points computed this session.
figures.alt: Scatter over years: GPT-2 cluster near 3.5–4.5, Pythia family near or below zero at 2023, modern-2024 diamonds ~4–5, and three 2026 stars at ~5.5–5.8 at the top right.

figures.caption: Same baseline IOI logit-diff vs parameter count (log-x), with the 2026 flagships (stars) added. GPT-2 family and both modern generations solve IOI strongly; the Pythia family sits at/below zero regardless of scale.
figures.alt: Log-x scatter of IOI logit-diff vs params: GPT-2 line 3.5–4.5, Pythia line near/below 0, modern-2024 and 2026 points at 4–5.8.

notes: 2026 models are BEHAVIOURAL-only (as instructed): the easy_transformer fork / TransformerLens cannot load qwen3_5 or gemma4_unified and nnsight cannot wrap them, so no circuit discovery / faithfulness for them — this shows behaviour survival, not circuit survival.

All prior (GPT-2, Pythia, 2024 modern) numbers reused verbatim from 001 living-update + run/replication; every 2026 number is from this session (200 IOI prompts, single-token-name filter, END next-token scoring).

Loader: AutoModelForImageTextToText, dtype=bfloat16, offline from local cache. Text decoder is m.model.language_model (32 layers Qwen3.5 / 48 gemma-4), not m.language_model as the instruction sketch had it. Fresh venv (transformers 5.17.0) since the reused 001 venv 4.46.3 lacks qwen3_5. No /home writes.
gemma-4-12B was fully downloaded (23GB) and hookable, so included as a genuine second 2026 point (base). Release years are approximate, used only for the over-time x-axis.
